carillas-porcelana.title: Porcelain veneers
carillas-porcelana.subtitle: Porcelain veneers & feldspathic artistry
carillas-porcelana.shortDescription: Ultra-thin feldspathic ceramic laminates, hand-shaped by master ceramists to recreate the translucency, opalescence and texture of natural enamel at its best.
detailedDescription: At Odontogamma Oriente, we treat porcelain veneers like fine watchmaking. Unlike conventional veneers or composite resin, each veneer is layered one coat at a time with imported ceramic powders that faithfully reproduce the three-dimensional nuances of a natural tooth.

Our minimally invasive protocol preserves as much healthy tooth structure as possible, creating a micro-precise bond to the enamel for lasting durability, with stable, stain-resistant results that keep their shine with proper care.
Every treatment begins with a digital smile analysis and a physical mock-up, so you can see and approve your new smile before any permanent work begins.
highlights: Ultra-thin (0.2 to 0.4 mm), with no aggressive tooth reduction
Highly resistant to stains from coffee, wine or tobacco
idealFor: Gaps between teeth (diastemas) and uneven tooth shapes
Deep stains that don't respond to whitening
Patients who want a radiant smile that looks 100% natural

beforeAfter.description: A patient with worn incisal edges and reduced tooth length. Ceramic laminates were designed with fine surface texture and custom edge translucency.

odontologia-cosmetica.title: Cosmetic dentistry
odontologia-cosmetica.subtitle: Cosmetic dentistry & facial design
odontologia-cosmetica.tagline: Aesthetic harmony that enhances your natural features
odontologia-cosmetica.shortDescription: Comprehensive planning that blends the shape of your lips, the frame of your face and your smile line for a subtle, elegant dental rejuvenation.
detailedDescription: High-end cosmetic dentistry goes beyond straightening teeth: it looks at how your smile works with your eyes, your lips and your expressions when you talk and laugh.
We analyze the golden proportions of your face with studio macro photography and 3D modeling to design a smile that takes years off and boosts your confidence.
We combine gum contouring with a diode laser, enamel micro-aesthetics and digital design to sculpt a perfectly balanced result.
highlights: Laser gum contouring with no bleeding or stitches
A try-in (aesthetic mock-up) before we start
Precise correction of smile width and tooth display
idealFor: Gummy smile (excess gum showing when you smile)
Teeth that look small for the frame of your lips
Noticeable asymmetry in your smile line
Anyone looking for a full smile rejuvenation

beforeAfter.description: Correction of wear and flattened edges with ceramic veneers, restoring brightness, width and balance to the face.

proceso-transformacion.title: Smile makeover process
proceso-transformacion.subtitle: The path to your smile makeover
proceso-transformacion.tagline: A private, transparent and predictable experience
proceso-transformacion.shortDescription: A guided 4-phase journey designed so that every detail of your new smile is planned, approved and carried out with the utmost precision.
detailedDescription: Transforming your smile at Odontogamma Oriente is an exclusive journey, and you're the star. From the very first diagnostic visit, we remove the guesswork by letting you see and feel what your final smile will look like.
We combine 3D intraoral scanning (no messy impression material), computerized virtual simulation and robotic fabrication with an artist's hand finishing.
We make sure you get not only a beautiful smile, but also a functional, stable and truly comfortable bite.
highlights: Phase 1: diagnostic consultation, study photos and 3D scan
Phase 2: digital simulation and mock-up try-in
Phase 3: elite fabrication in a state-of-the-art lab
Phase 4: final bonding under isolation, then polishing
idealFor: Patients who want a complete, lasting smile transformation
People who value predictability and want to see the result before they begin
Complex cases with older restorations that are worn or no longer fit well

beforeAfter.description: Ultra-thin porcelain veneers with enamel layering for maximum translucency and a soft, natural smile.

aclaramiento-laser.title: Advanced teeth whitening
aclaramiento-laser.subtitle: Advanced cold-light whitening
aclaramiento-laser.tagline: Bright, natural-looking whiteness without pain or sensitivity
aclaramiento-laser.shortDescription: Combined in-office and at-home protocols using photocatalyzed cold light to break down deep organic stains while respecting the tooth's natural structure.
detailedDescription: Unlike harsh bleaching that dehydrates the tooth and causes uncomfortable sensitivity, our advanced whitening protocol uses photocatalysis technology with remineralizing agents.
We restore youthful brightness and a harmonious shade without eroding enamel or affecting the health of the tooth.
We include custom-fitted whitening trays and maintenance gels to keep your smile bright for years.
highlights: Comfortable procedure with maximum enamel protection
Deep, bright whitening in a single visit
Exclusive maintenance kit for lasting shine
idealFor: Teeth stained by coffee, tea, mate, red wine or tobacco
Patients with a special event coming up who want immediate results

beforeAfter.description: Correction of mild crowding in the front teeth and added brightness with minimal-prep ceramic veneers.
